title: 4BR Rosemary Beach Cottage with a Private Pool & a Hot Tub
meta_description: Sylvia's Cottage, a 4BR, 3BA Rosemary Beach, FL cottage, with private beach access, a private pool and hot tub, a covered carport, and 4 free bikes. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love* Large courtyard with private pool and hot tub (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)* Covered carport * Screen room above carport with Adirondack furnishings and ping-pong table* Stainless steel Viking appliances* 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser BikesSylvia’s Cottage has several coveted amenities, including just a 2-minute walk to the beach, making Sylvia’s Cottage a most special choice for your next Rosemary Beach vacation.With New Orleans-inspired architecture, this 4-bedroom, 3-bath home is the ideal escape for those who love the outdoors. Featuring more than 1500 square feet of porches and patios and another 3,000 square feet of decadent outdoor amenities, Sylvia’s Cottage boasts an unusually large outdoor living space for the area.Sun lovers will gather around the built-in pool, with nearby loungers, to soak up the Vitamin D. Those who prefer the cool shade have plenty of space on either a covered patio or in the oversized screen room above the carport, overlooking the entire neighborhood. Lounge on Adirondack furniture or challenge a friend to a rousing game of ping-pong. After the sun has set, enjoy the warm bubbles of the built-in hot tub as the evening stars twinkle above.The first floor of Sylvia’s Cottage offers a lovely combination of rustic elegance, with hardwood and natural stone floors, stainless steel, and farmhouse touches. Relax in the spacious living room, with an abundance of comfortable furnishings, a large screen TV, and neutral decor to promote peace and tranquility.The large chef’s kitchen boasts granite countertops, a brick backsplash, stainless steel Viking appliances, and a center island. The adjacent farmhouse table for 8 complements the island seating for two to ensure the entire family has a seat at the table.With just one bedroom on the lower level, someone will get to enjoy the ultimate privacy! This sanctuary boasts a King-size bed, window seat by which to enjoy a few pages of your book, or some social media time, two nightstands, and lamps for bedtime reading and a flat-screen TV for evening entertainment. Best of all, you’ll have your own private patio, ideal for a late-night glass of wine. A full bath is adjacent.On the second level of Sylvia’s Cottage, guests will find 3 additional bedrooms. The Queen bedroom with a private balcony and the kid’s room with built-in bunk beds share a hall bath with a tub/shower. The second King master also has a private balcony. The en-suite bath features dual vanities and a spacious walk-in shower.The home's second level also features a comfortable den, complete with sofa, chair and a big flat-screen TV. It’s the perfect getaway for the kids or the adults.Make your reservations for Sylvia’s Cottage soon! We look forward to welcoming you.FIRST FLOOR* Living room with beams, recessed lighting, ceiling fan, flat-screen TV, and seating for 6* Dining room farmhouse table for 8* Kitchen with center island with seating for two, granite counters, brick backsplash, stainless steel Viking appliances* BEDROOM with King bed, window seat, two nightstands with lamps, ceiling fan, private access to patio, flat-screen TV* Hall bathSECOND FLOOR* MASTER BEDROOM SUITE with King bed, two nightstands, and lamps, recessed lighting, ceiling fan, private access to patio. Master bath features dual vanities and oversized walk-in shower* BEDROOM with Queen bed, seating area, nightstands and lamps, ceiling fan, double dresser, flat-screen TV, private access to patio* BEDROOM with built-in bunk set, dresser, flat-screen TV, ceiling fan* Den with sofa, chair with ottoman, bookshelf, flat-screen TVSTR-034786 TDT-034186
